$comment: Performance budgets (#108), checked by `npm run budgets` in CI's budgets job. Raise a number only in a pull request that says why. Kernel and viewport baselines are a CI runner's own medians (2 to 3 times a laptop's); the check fails when a median is over its baseline by more than the tolerance. totalJs went from 824 to 826 for Remove duplicates in sketches: main was at about 822.6, and the finder is a 2.7 KB chunk that loads only when you run it. totalJs went from 896 to 900 for Auto dimension (#566) and drawings that follow the model (#568): about 2.3 KB and 2.1 KB in the drawing chunk, loaded only when a drawing opens (the ranked list of sizes and its card; re-stacking rows after a model change and the warnings for lost marks and dimensions); the shell grows 0.6 KB for the two commands and the problem count on the browser row, and stays under its cap at 398.2. The Drawing workspace has its own line from #570: its chunk is 34.3 KB with release 1 in it, and 45 leaves room for release 2 (section views, more sheets, notes, a parts list) before anyone has to look again. totalJs went from 900 to 906 for more than one sheet in a drawing (#572): 3 KB in the drawing chunk (the strip of sheets, moving a view between sheets and a PDF with a page per sheet), and 0.4 KB in the shell for which sheet is open; the shell stays under its cap at 398.2. totalJs went from 906 to 912 for section, detail and broken views (#571): 6.8 KB in the drawing chunk (hatching, cutting a view's curves to a circle or round a break, the three tools' card and what they draw on the parent view), 1 KB in the kernel worker for the cut, and nothing in the shell, which is at 398.0. The drawing chunk is at 44.1 of 45: the next part of release 2 should move Export and its writers to their own chunk rather than raise the line. totalJs went from 912 to 918 for notes, symbols and tolerances on drawings (#573): about 7 KB, all of it in the drawing chunks, which load only when a drawing opens. Export and the tolerance card moved to chunks of their own so the drawing chunk stays under its 45 KB. The drawing line went from 45 to 50 and totalJs from 918 to 924 for the parts list, balloons and Make drawings of every part (#574): 3.8 KB that the sheet needs to draw the table and number the balloons, and a 1 KB chunk for the command that loads when you run it. The drawing line now counts the drawing chunk and every chunk it imports outright, less the shell's, so splitting it cannot hide growth. totalJs went from 924 to 930 for your own title block and drawing templates (#575): main was at 921.6, and the set-up card with its logo, fields and templates is now a 6 KB chunk of its own that loads only when you open New drawing or Sheet settings (taking it out of the drawing workspace keeps that under its 50). totalJs went from 930 to 931 for the admin console's sign-ins and projects (#601): main was at about 929.4, and the admin page lives in the lazy pages chunk that only #/admin and the other pages load. The shell went from 400 to 402 and totalJs from 944 to 970 for the electronics workspace (#607): main was at 399.8 and 943.4. The schematic, the board, their cards, the design's own code (nets, the change list, the starter parts) and the views' shortcuts are one chunk that loads the first time a view opens, about 22 KB, with its own Electronics workspace line at 26; later phases (the library, checks, routing, manufacturing files) go in chunks of their own. At first paint the shell gains about 1.8 KB: thirteen icons and their colour drawings for the Electronics tab and tools, the sixteen board and schematic colours in three themes, the tab, the two commands that open a view, the browser's Electronics rows and the small view-state store they all share. totalJs went from 1010 to 1016 and the drawing workspace from 52 to 54 for Edit in model (#564): main was at 1010.2 and 51.0, and the size-to-model lookup (0.9 KB) and the size properties panel (0.9 KB) are chunks of their own that load when you use them; sharing the dimension code with that panel split it into a chunk the workspace still loads, which is the other 1 KB. totalJs went from 1016 to 1018 for exploded drawing views (#574): the Explode field and its note in the view's properties chunk and the kernel worker's moving of each group (about 0.7 KB, all in lazy chunks; the shell did not change), on top of half, stepped and slanted sections, which had left 0.7 KB of room. totalJs then went from 1018 to 1048 for the board's tools (#610): main was at 1010.2 of 1010 once Make external (#674) and this epic's schematic tools (#677) had both landed, and routing, the board check, board setup with its board house presets and the numbers of what is picked add 16.7 KB across chunks that load when the PCB view, a card or a selection first needs them; the electronics chunk moves 1.1 KB (the PCB tools and their commands) and the shell 0.1 KB. The shell went from 403 to 408 and totalJs from 1048 to 1056 for pours and the board in 3D (#610, #611): the Board step is a modelling step, so what builds it loads with the model code that builds every other step (the board as a solid from the design, its bodies and the step itself, 3.6 KB), 1 KB of outline and footprint geometry it shares moved out of the electronics chunk to sit beside it, and pours, keep-outs, the outline from a sketch and the picture of the copper on the board's faces add 11.2 KB in chunks that load with the PCB view or the first board; main was at 402.5 and 1032.7. totalJs went from 1056 to 1070 for the files a board house needs (#612): the order card with the Gerber, drill, parts list and order pack writers, the three houses' columns and the spreadsheet writer (11.9 KB) and the reader and preview that draw the files back (6.3 KB) are chunks that load when Order the board, and then its preview, are first opened; the shell and the electronics chunk grow 0.1 and 0.2 KB for the tool and its command. Main was at 1047.6. The Pico servo board sample (#666) is in that 1070 too: about 2.7 KB that builds the sample's schematic and board, beside the other samples' builders, loaded when a sample opens. totalJs went from 1070 to 1080 for Export to KiCad (#664): the writer of the KiCad project (schematic, board, the two libraries and the project file) is an 8.4 KB chunk that loads when you pick KiCad in Export; the shell and the electronics workspace do not grow. totalJs went from 1080 to 1095 for Open a KiCad project (#663): the reader of a KiCad schematic and board (hierarchy, buses, outline, tracks, zones and rules) with its dialog is a 12.9 KB chunk that loads when project files are first picked; the shell and the electronics workspace grow 0.4 and 0.3 KB for the tool, its command and the button on an empty schematic. totalJs went from 1095 to 1110 for Eagle and Fusion Electronics files (#665): the reader of an Eagle schematic and board is a chunk of about 8 KB that loads when Eagle files are first picked in Open project, and the reader of Eagle libraries adds about 4 KB to the part tools chunk, which loads with New part and Import parts; the shell and the electronics workspace do not grow. totalJs went from 1110 to 1120 for the symbol editor (#626): main was at 1104.2, and drawing a symbol by hand (shapes, pins, units, its own undo) adds 6.9 KB: a 3.9 KB chunk that loads when you choose Drawn by hand in the part editor, and about 3 KB of symbol editing and checks in the part tools chunk, which loads with New part; the shell and the electronics workspace do not grow. The shell went from 408 to 409 and totalJs from 1120 to 1130 for a STEP file as a part's 3D body (#628): main was at 408.0 and 1117.0. The Board step, which the model builder in the shell runs, now makes a body for each solid in a part's file (0.3 KB); reading the file, keeping it by hash and the editor's controls load with the Components panel and the part editor (3.7 KB), and the electronics workspace grows 0.6 KB to copy a part's file into the model when the part is placed. totalJs went from 1130 to 1140 for pictures and copper text on boards (#641, #642): the branch was at 1128.0 and is 1132.4 with them. The 4.4 KB is the silkscreen picture code (reading a picture file into ink, its card and its regions in the silkscreen file), text in copper with several lines, a pad's own join to its pour and the ink over a pad check, all in chunks that load with the board view, its cards or the files for the board house; the shell does not grow and stays at 408.4. totalJs went from 1140 to 1156 and the Electronics workspace from 26 to 27 for the board check in a worker, quicker big boards and a board's shape from a face or a DXF file (#638, #640, #644): main was at 1132.4 and 25.8, and totalJs is now 1150.3. The DXF reader is a chunk of its own, fetched when a file is picked, and the face outline rides in the Board setup card's chunk; together they are about 4 KB. The worker is a file of its own (12.1 KB) that holds the check and the board maths it needs, fetched when the Board check card first opens; a worker cannot share the page's chunks, so that code is there twice. Sliding a piece of track is 1 KB in the board view's chunk. The workspace chunk grows 0.2 KB, to 26.0, for keeping the nets while only the board changes and looking at a wire's box before measuring to it, which is what took a 1,750 part board from two seconds an edit to under a tenth; the shell stays at 408.4. The shell went from 409 to 411 and totalJs from 1156 to 1164 for the board and the model in step (#650, #651, #652, #654, #657, #659): main was at 408.5 and 1150.9, and they are 410.2 and 1160.5 with it. The shell gains 1.7 KB because these are modelling steps the model builder runs: standoffs that follow the board's holes, the opening a connector cuts through a wall, and a moved board part going back to the layout or being put back where it was, with the Connector opening command. The other 8 KB is in chunks that load when used: moving board parts and holes in 3D and working out an opening (2.6 KB, fetched on the first move of a board part), the made-board view and pin 1 marks in the files preview (1.5 KB), pictures on faces in the path-traced render, shared meshes and the two new steps in the kernel worker, and the standoff pattern in the Mount card. totalJs went from 1200 to 1212 for Draw on in the Render view: it is 1210.5 with it. About 10.6 KB in its own chunk, loaded only when you press Draw on: the bloom pass, the edge tour and its shaders. None of it is in the shell or the render chunk. totalJs went from 1216 to 1219 for camera moves in the Render view: about 2.4 KB in the lazy Render chunk (five presets, the move player, Save video for a move), nothing in the shell (410.9 of 411). totalJs went from 1219 to 1237 for Video render (camera moves path-traced frame by frame): a 15.4 KB chunk with the MP4 and WebM muxers that loads only when a video render starts, and about 1 KB in the Render chunk for the one Play button and its modes. The shell grows 15 bytes (the video file name) and stays at 410.9. totalJs went from 1237 to 1239 for Draw on backgrounds: the Render backgrounds, a floor and a see-through pass in the lazy Draw on chunk. drawing went from 54 to 56 and totalJs from 1239 to 1241 for a calmer Auto dimension: it adds about 1.6 KB to the Drawing workspace chunk (pattern copies, copied bodies, bolt circles and slivers left out, pattern notes, the suggested amount). Its live preview runs as you move the slider, so it stays in the workspace chunk; none of it is in the shell. totalJs went from 1243 to 1244 for the Black background and the Holoroom room in Draw on. totalJs went from 1244 to 1247 for nets in the inspector: a 2.4 KB NetProps chunk (class picker, net width, what is on the net) that loads only when a track, via, wire or label is selected in the electronics workspace, plus 0.2 KB in BoardProps; the electronics workspace chunk is at 27.5 of 28 and the shell does not change. totalJs went from 1247 to 1248 for the video render recovering from a graphics reset (PR #726): main was at about 1246.8, and it adds about 0.3 KB in the lazy render chunk (a new tracer in a new canvas when the card drops the context, and the Render view's picture doing the same). totalJs went from 1248 to 1253 for the first electronics quick wins (#728, #730, #731, #732, #734): a 1.5 KB Find chunk that loads when the find box opens, the measure tool and the stroke font in the lazy board chunk, a colour search icon, and 0.3 KB in the electronics workspace chunk for the two tools; the shell grows 0.1 KB for the Electronics tab opening a view. The Electronics workspace line went from 28 to 30 for notes on a sheet (#733): text, lines, boxes and circles drawn, picked, moved, copied and edited on the canvas are about 1.3 KB in the electronics chunk, which loads only when a view opens; the Draw tools themselves are a few rows in the ribbon. totalJs went from 1253 to 1262 for the third batch of the electronics review (#727): notes on a sheet (#733, about 1.3 KB in the electronics chunk), open vias and net colours (#736, #740, under 1 KB with the PCB view) and Calculators (#739, its own chunk of about 3 KB that loads when the card opens); the shell is unchanged at 411.8. totalJs went from 1262 to 1275 for the third batch of the electronics review: the pin table, fiducials and test points and dragging corners (#742) in the electronics chunk, and stitching vias (#737) and board copy and paste (#741), each its own chunk loaded only when asked; about 6 KB, with room for the next issue or two. totalJs went from 1275 to 1290 for the fourth and fifth batches of the electronics review: pads of any shape (#744), length matching (#745, its own chunk, loaded when a track is picked) and fan-out (#746, in the router's worker and a chunk loaded when you press Fan out); about 9 KB, with room for the next issue or two.

bundle.$comment: KB gzipped, per chunk. The shell is the JavaScript index.html loads before first paint. totalJs went from 600 to 620 in #312: main was already at 601.9 after the text tool (#309) added fonts (glyphs, 50 KB, loaded only when you place text), alongside the path tracer (63 KB, loaded only for Render); the shell cap is what guards first paint. The shell went from 355 to 358 in #310: main was at 354.6, and dragging an arm by its tool point (#176) adds 1.2 KB of glue (the tool marker, the palette commands, the lock toggle) after its solver and drag moved to a lazy chunk. 358 to 361 in the clash check (#178): main was at 357.9, and the check adds 0.8 KB (its state, the overlap boxes, the command); its list and the kernel work load later. What's new (#319) adds 0.4 KB (the Help entry, the command and the hook); the notes, the seen list, the card and the dialog load later. totalJs went from 620 to 630 with named poses (#177): main was at 618.1 and they add 1.9 KB; everything past first paint loads on use. The shell went from 355 to 356 when dragging into components (#334) added 1.1 KB (drop onto a row in the tree, the Move into menu, the moves saved with the model) to a main at 354.5. totalJs went from 630 to 632 with components (#171): main was at about 629.3 after the shell trim (#332) split code into lazy chunks, and components add 1.0 KB (the nested browser, the active component, two icons). The shell went from 361 to 362 for dropping a sketch point on another point or a line to join it (#326): main was at 360.7, and the drag glue adds 0.4 KB (the snap while dragging, the coincident on drop); finding what it drops on loads with the sketch. The clash sweep (#179) adds 0.1 KB (its command and the panel props); the sweep, its state and the mesh test load later. totalJs went from 632 to 636 for the Parameters dialog with Model parameters: main was at about 631.6, and the dialog's chunk grows by about 2.5 KB (the steps' sizes, the filter, the comment column); it loads only when Parameters opens, and the shell moves 0.3 KB. Revolve's axis pick (#342) took the shell from 357 to 358 and totalJs from 639 to 642: main was at the shell cap, and the step's axis state, the axis button and help add about 0.5 KB at first paint after the picking itself (axisPick) and Construct's pick geometry (pickGeo) moved to lazy chunks; the rest loads with the Revolve tool. #320 took the shell to under 355 and the cap back to 355: the move gizmo (TransformControls), the catalogue's parts list, file import and the problem report's zip code now load after first paint. totalJs went from 637 to 639 for the tips card (#340): main was at about 636.8, and the card and its tips add 1.3 KB in their own chunk, loaded only when it shows; the shell moves 0.3 KB (the hook, the Help entry, the bulb icon). Pattern of features (copy a hole or stub onto the same body, round a construction axis, #343) took the shell from 358 to 359 and totalJs from 642 to 644: main was at about 357.2 and 641.1, and it adds 0.8 KB to the shell (copying ops with moves in the kernel document, the axis pick, the step picked on the timeline, the release note) and about 0.8 KB more in the kernel worker (the same document code) and the lazy Pattern bar. totalJs went from 644 to 650 for the build steps export (#348): main was at about 644.2, and the export adds 4.5 KB in its own chunk (the instructions, the offscreen step pictures, the zip), loaded only when you pick Build steps; the shell moves 0.3 KB (the menu entry and the command). The origin's X, Y and Z axes in the browser (#350) took the shell from 359 to 360: main was at about 358.5, and the three rows, their eyes, the axis colours and picking them for Pattern and Joint add about 0.5 KB of glue in the editor and the view. totalJs went from 650 to 652 for the tall feature panels: main was at about 649, and the panel (rows, pickers with an ×, tick boxes, folding) adds about 1.1 KB in a chunk that loads with the first tool; the shell does not move. totalJs went from 652 to 654 for faster extrude dragging: main was at about 651.0, and it adds about 1.1 KB (the ghost the drag draws, in the lazy arrow chunk, and the kernel worker keeping each body part way through its steps); the shell does not move. totalJs went from 656 to 659 for one panel for joints: main was at about 656, and the joint panel (both components with their snaps, the line-up and motion fields) and lining a component up on its joint (the move maths, in the shell's document code and again in the kernel worker) add about 1.7 KB; the tool and its panel load on first use, so the shell does not grow. totalJs went from 659 to 663 for topological naming (#47): main was at about 659, and naming faces and edges through each step adds about 2 KB to the kernel worker (and the Properties panel now loads in its own chunk, which took the shell from 359.9 to 358.3). totalJs went from 663 to 665 for the performance overlay (#42): main was at about 662.2 after rebuild progress (#364), and the overlay (its graph, the kernel step timings) now loads in its own chunk when turned on, which costs about 0.8 KB in all; the shell does not grow. totalJs went from 665 to 667 when main reached 665.2 after the alpha note (#368), sketches moving with their component (#369), round-edge joint snaps (#367) and the one-row timeline (#370) landed together, about 2 KB between them; the shell stays under its cap. Saved section analyses took the shell from 360 to 361: main was at about 359.3, and the Analysis folder, its eyes and menu, the Section tool editing a saved one and the document code for them add about 0.9 KB of glue in the browser and the view. totalJs went from 667 to 670 for snapping sketches to the model and the loupe that shows the view: main was at about 666.6, and they add about 2 KB in two chunks that load on first use (the model's snap targets when you first draw, the loupe's renderer when it first opens); the shell does not grow. totalJs went from 670 to 672 for the admin console: main was at about 669.6, and the page (every user and their models) adds about 1.5 KB to the pages chunk, which loads only off the editor; the shell moves 0.1 KB (the route and the menu entry). Fillets where faces pinch to a point (#377) and cleaner cuts on curved faces (#379) add about 0.9 KB to the kernel worker (the local round: the solid side of each face, the piece carved off and put back; the fuzzy boolean set-up) and their release notes, leaving main at about 671.3; the shell does not grow. totalJs went from 672 to 675 for joint snap points (#383, #384): main was at about 671.4, and finding a face's snap points and drawing them (round dots, the hovered one's axes) add about 2.3 KB to the joint tool's chunk, which loads on first use; the shell moves 0.1 KB (the pale hover face and its tokens). totalJs went from 675 to 677 for the joint loupe (#385, #386, #387): main was at about 673.7, and the loupe over crowded joint snaps, its close hint and the Settings switch add about 1.9 KB in the Joint tool's chunk; the shell went from 361 to 362 for it: main was at about 360.8, and the Settings switch and the sketch's check of it add about 0.3 KB at first paint (a lazy-loaded switch could not load offline from the cached app, so it stays in Settings). totalJs went from 677 to 679 for sharp corners behind rounds and bevels (#389) and the middle between two picks (#388): main was at about 675.6, and finding the cut-away corners, drawing them dashed and the Shift-click middle add about 1.3 KB to the Joint tool's chunk, which loads on first use; the view now gives each face's edge numbers (Engine.faceEdgeIds, about 0.1 KB at first paint). totalJs went from 679 to 682 for Send to kevsrobots: main was at about 678.5, and the dialog (pick or make a project, send, update) and the projects.kevsrobots.com client add about 2.6 KB in their own chunk, loaded only when you pick Send to kevsrobots; the shell moves 0.2 KB (the menu entry, the command and the link saved in the model). totalJs went from 682 to 685 for lining up hole patterns (#393) and snaps on imported meshes (#395): main was at about 681.8, and matching the holes and the mesh box snaps add about 1.4 KB to the Joint tool's chunk, which loads on first use; the shell moves 0.1 KB (Engine.bodyBox). totalJs went from 685 to 687 for turning a circle pattern round an edge picked on the model: main was at about 685, and picking the edge or round face adds about 0.5 KB in its own chunk, loaded on the first pick; the shell moves 0.4 KB (the Pattern tool's pick step and the kept axis). The shell went from 362 to 363 for listing a part's joints in This part: main was at its cap, and lighting the picked joint in the view and opening it for editing add about 0.2 KB at first paint; the list itself loads with the Properties panel. totalJs went from 687 to 689 for holding a face with Shift in the Joint tool and ghosting the other side's part: main was at about 687.2, and the hold, the ghosted bodies and the release note add about 0.1 KB; the hold and the ghost list are in the Joint tool's chunk, and the shell moves under 0.1 KB (passing the ghosted bodies to the view). totalJs went from 689 to 690 for linking joints so they move together (motion links): it reached 689.0, and the Link joints dialog (in the drive dialog's chunk, loaded on use), the Link button in This part and the motion link maths (in the shell's document code and again in the kernel worker) add about 1 KB; the shell moves 0.1 KB (the command and the Link handler). The shell went from 363 to 366 and totalJs from 690 to 698 for tracks round wheels (Pattern's Track kind): main was already over both caps at 364.9 and 693.9 after #423, and laying a track round its wheels has to be in the document code the editor builds with, about 0.5 KB at first paint (the belt loop, the chain of pins, the moved-and-turned copy); picking the pins and wheels, the lift and the fit load with the Pattern panel, and the same document code is in the kernel worker, about 3.3 KB in all. The shell went from 366 to 368 and totalJs from 698 to 702 for picking the parts of overlapping sketch shapes: main was at 365.7 and 697.9, and cutting curves where they cross (with tangent touches and projected face edges) is part of finding regions, which the document code the editor builds with runs on every extrude, so it cannot load later; about 1.7 KB at first paint and the same again in the kernel worker. The shell went from 368 to 369 for where an extrude starts (profile plane, offset or object): main was at 367.4, and working out the start is in the document code the editor builds with, about 0.6 KB at first paint; the Start row, its picking and the arrow's start load with the Extrude panel and arrow. totalJs went from 702 to 704 for it: main was at about 701.6, and the same start code is in the kernel worker too. Showing only the active component's steps on the timeline adds about 0.5 KB at first paint (the filter, its toggle, stepping between the steps shown) and 0.4 KB more in its own chunk (finding the steps); main was at about 703.2, so totalJs went from 704 to 705 for it. totalJs went from 705 to 707 for tracks running round their wheels: main was at about 704.1, and sliding the pieces round the loop as a wheel turns adds about 1 KB in its own chunk, loaded only for a model with a track, plus 0.2 KB at first paint (the built track list and the editor glue). totalJs went from 707 to 709 for joint snaps on imported meshes: main was at about 705.8, and growing the flat or curved run of triangles under the pointer into a face with its snaps adds about 1.6 KB to the Joint tool's chunk, which loads on first use; the shell moves 0.1 KB (Engine.bodyMesh). The shell went from 369 to 370 for colour cycling (Shift+N): main was at 368.8, and the toggle has to be at first paint (the command and its key, the view style menu entry, the view recolouring each part by its component), about 0.3 KB; there is nothing in it to load later. totalJs went from 709 to 722 for turning an imported STL's holes into Hole steps (#437): main was at about 708.6, and the recogniser (welding the mesh, flat faces, round rims, hole walls) is about 7 KB in a chunk the kernel worker loads when the tool first runs, the tool's panel and rim overlay about 3.9 KB in a chunk loaded when it opens, and the Convert step (filling the chosen holes, a hole's own head size) is in the document code the editor builds with and again in the kernel worker, about 0.7 KB at first paint with the command, the menu entry and the import hint; the shell stays under its cap at 369.7. The shell went from 370 to 371 for import progress: main was at 369.7, and the progress toast, knowing when an import's mesh is on show and drawing an STL from its own triangles until then add about 0.4 KB at first paint; reading the file and making that mesh load with the import code. totalJs went from 722 to 725 for it: main was at about 721.5, and reading an STL or 3MF in the app as well as in the kernel worker, and the worker's import progress, add about 1.8 KB, all but the shell's part loaded on the first import. The shell went from 371 to 372 and totalJs from 725 to 728 for rigid groups and STEP layouts: main was at about 370.2 and 724.9, and the Rigid group step has to be in the document code the editor builds with (the parts it carries when a joint lines one up, fixing its components to the jointed one for poses and URDF, a Move of them as one) and in the view (the move gizmo carrying the locked parts), about 1.5 KB at first paint and the same document code again in the kernel worker; making a group and recording its moves load on first use. The shell went from 372 to 373 and totalJs from 728 to 733 for Loft (#399): main was at 371.7 and 726.8, and the Loft step has to be in the document code the editor builds with (its shapes from each sketch, the same-plane check, its size and summary), with the tool button, its icon and the editor glue, about 1.0 KB at first paint; the tool and its panel are 3.2 KB in their own chunk, loaded when you pick Loft, and the document code and the loft itself are in the kernel worker too, about 0.8 KB. The shell went from 373 to 375 and totalJs from 733 to 740 for Sweep (#400): main was at about 372.7 and 731.8, and the Sweep step has to be in the document code the editor builds with (its shapes, putting the path's lines and arcs end to end, its size and summary), with the tool button, its icon and the editor glue, about 1.7 KB at first paint; the tool and its panel load in their own chunk when you pick Sweep, and the document code and the sweep itself are in the kernel worker too. The shell went from 375 to 377 and totalJs from 740 to 744 for ellipses (#401): main was at 374.6 and 739.3, and an ellipse is a sketch curve like a circle, so the solver rules for its axes, finding regions round it and where it crosses lines and curves, picking and drawing it, and the Ellipse tool are in the sketch code the editor builds with, about 2.3 KB at first paint; the same regions and the ellipse edges are in the kernel worker too. The shell went from 377 to 379 and totalJs from 744 to 746 for centre and tangent arcs (#405): the branch measures 377.9 and 744.1, and the Arc tool's kinds (the kind buttons, the centre and tangent previews, which way a tangent arc turns, a line carrying on tangent from an arc) are in the sketch code the editor builds with, about 1 KB at first paint; there is no lazy sketch tool chunk to put them in. totalJs went from 746 to 749 for Split body (#406): main was at 743.9, and the Split step is in the document code the editor builds with and again in the kernel worker (the step, its halves, the plane's tool box), about 1.5 KB, with the tool and its panel in their own chunk, loaded when you pick Split body; the shell moves 0.6 KB (the step's document code, the tool button and icon). The shell went from 379 to 380 and totalJs from 749 to 751 for sketch mirror (#267): main was at 378.4 and 748.7, and mirroring shapes across a line (the copies, their Symmetric ties, the shared points on the line), the Mirror tool, its pick bar and its release note are in the sketch code the editor builds with, about 0.9 KB at first paint; there is no lazy sketch tool chunk to put them in. totalJs went from 751 to 752 for extend and trim by dragging (#270): main was at about 750.9, and they add about 0.8 KB; they, and Mirror before them, now load in their own chunk (@bettercad/sketch/edits) when Mirror or Trim is picked, which took the shell back to 379.3. wasm.$comment: MB. OCCT is the opencascade.js build replicad ships (23 MB); the issue's 12 MB / 3.5 MB target needs a slimmer build of the same unmodified OCCT (#4, #50).

viewport.$comment: Since #204 the view fills the 1280 x 800 window (3.3 times the pixels it had), and the frame is 34 to 84 ms on runners depending on the runner (the kernel numbers swing by the same factor in the same runs). Baseline 90 leaves the same headroom over a fast runner as the kernel budgets have.

lighthouse.$comment: Desktop preset, Chromium with SwiftShader as CI runs it. Software WebGL compiles the view's shaders on the main thread (about 1 s of blocking time); with WebGL off the score is 100. The target is 0.85. The score swings from about 0.55 to 0.73 on the same code from runner to runner, so it warns rather than blocks (performanceBlocks false): budgets.mjs reports it in the table and as a warning annotation. Installable still blocks.
